# Illustration prompts

<!-- Generated by apps/website/scripts/illustration-prompts.ts from
     apps/website/src/data/illustrations.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

One self-contained prompt per illustration slot (43 slots). Each prompt
carries the whole style from [ILLUSTRATIONS.md](ILLUSTRATIONS.md), so it can be
handed to an image-generation agent on its own. Save each result as the named
WebP file, at the exact size, in `apps/website/src/assets/illustrations/`; the slot
switches from its texel fallback to the file on the next build. A dark variant
is optional.

## home-hero

- File: `home-hero.webp`, optional dark variant `home-hero-dark.webp`
- Size: 1200×1000 pixels (landing plate)
- Alt text on the page: Isometric 3D scene of a browser window and a phone assembled from violet, pearl and orange cubes

```text
Subject: a large pearl-white browser window floating center-right, its sidebar showing a violet home glyph plus small grid, user and gear glyphs, its content area showing an image card, a bar-chart card, an orange pie-chart card and a column of list rows; beside it, slightly in front on the right, a smartphone showing an image card, a toggle switch and a violet button. Around and behind them a cluster of violet, pearl, lilac-glass and a few orange cubes stacks up like building blocks that assemble the interface, with dashed connector lines from floating cubes to the window. In the foreground, a row of single cubes, each embossed with one interface glyph (toggle, gear, 2x2 grid). The idea: any interface, built from small pieces. Composition: the scene fills the frame, slightly weighted to the right. The only exception to the no-text rule: one single pearl cube may carry the Texuli isotype embossed on its front face, a capital T built from square cells (three cells across the top, a column of cells below), rendered as a raised glyph, not as lettering. Style: a soft 3D isometric product illustration. Camera: isometric three-quarter view at about 30 degrees, orthographic feel, no perspective distortion. Materials: rounded-edge cubes ("texels") in a soft clay and glossy plastic finish, some cubes in frosted lilac glass; pearl-white interface panels with rounded corners and soft violet fills; thin dashed lilac connector lines. Lighting: diffuse studio light from the top left, gentle ambient occlusion, soft contact shadows on a faintly reflective floor that fades into the background. Palette: pearl white #F7F5FB for about 60% of the image, primary violet #6D4AFF to #7C5CFF for about 25%, lilac glass #B9A8FF to #E6DEFF for about 10%, and warm orange #FF8A4C to #FFA36B only as a small highlight, about 5%. Background: a smooth, very light gradient from lavender #F4F0FF to peach #FFF4EE. Interface glyphs are simple shapes only (a mountain-and-sun image icon, bar chart, pie chart, toggle switch, gear, 2x2 grid, home glyph), and any text is drawn as skeleton lines (rounded bars). Mood: friendly, premium, airy, modular and calm, with generous negative space. No text: absolutely no letters, words, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. No people, no robots, no faces, no photographs, no dark background, no extra colors. Keep every important element inside the central 84% of the frame, with 8% margins on every side. Output: exactly 1200x1000 pixels (6:5), exported as WebP, saved as home-hero.webp. Optional dark variant: render the identical scene, same camera, cubes and colors, on a deep violet-ink gradient from #17142A to #221B3D instead of the light background, and save it as home-hero-dark.webp.
```
